newsitem.title: USA: Energy Ventures sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Energy Ventures sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Energy Ventures Inc said Friday the agenda for its next annual shareholders meeting includes a proposal to make a two-for-one stock split.
The company, which makes engineered oil field products, said the agenda also had a proposal to increase its common stock to 80 million shares from 40 million.
The board of directors has fixed May 12 as the record date for the proposed stock split and May 19 as the date for the issuance of the shares, it said.
The annual meeting, which is to be held May 6, will also consider a proposal to change the company's name to EVI Inc, it added.
